game:simpleteaguide-text: Tea Cooking Guide Brew flowers and herbs into potent drinks to stay hydrated and gain unique benefits. Higher temperatures significantly boost the effectiveness of every infusion. How to Brew: Add 1L of water and 1 botanical ingredient into a Cooking Pot. Once cooked, you can serve individual portions in Bowls or store large amounts in Buckets. Temperature Mechanics - Hot Tea: Stays hot for 4 hours. Fresh tea is significantly more powerful than cold tea. - Cold Tea: After 4 hours, the tea cools down and loses its potency bonus. - Note: Once cooled, tea cannot be reheated. Drink it while it stays hot for the best results! Tea Categories - Floral Tea: Higher satiety recovery. (Cornflower, Poppy, etc.) - Wild Tea: Simple satiety, easier to find. (Mint, Sage, Basill, etc.) - Medicinal Tea: Restores Health (HP). (Chamomile, Horsetail, etc.) - Bitter Tea: Warning: Toxic! Deals HP damage. (Wolfsbane, etc.) 1 L: - Floral Tea: A refined and sweet floral infusion. Potent while hot! Recovers 30 satiety. - Wild Tea: A simple field plant infusion. More effective while hot! Recovers 20 satiety. - Cold Floral Tea: A cold floral infusion. Recovers 15 satiety. - Cold Wild Tea: A simple infusion of field plants. Recovers 15 satiety.
